answer.book: A 1673 Tiguri disputation (Vol. 1, Pars prior) by Johann Heinrich Heidegger, defended by Thomas Veres-Egyhazi, with a dedication to Debrecen and its pastors, on Caput X of the Confessio Helvetica (predestination and election); its structure is unnumbered headings with § paragraphs, not a numbered series.
